programs.description: Driven by rising global temperatures, numerous wildlife species employ remarkable strategies for survival.

Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in "Natural Born Monsters." When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programs.showName: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programs.description: 37 different species of the predatory cats rule every conceivably wild area. A biologist unearths their success and their diverse family tree.

Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.
The filmmaker travels across the globe to document some of the strongest animals living on vast landscapes who have endured the rigors of nature.
The filmmaker sheds light on the fight for supremacy among a leap of leopards in the Sabi Sands Game Reserve of South Africa after their queen of 12 years is no more.
The filmmaker provides insights into some of the unique characteristics of various predatory animals while focusing on their survival instincts.
